demandNotes: Kern County's 55+ population is growing 2x faster than the state average. Limited residential care bed supply creates strong pricing power for licensed homes.
demographicNotes: Median age 33. 55+ population expected to increase 28% by 2030. Growing retiree inflow from higher-cost coastal areas.
description: DFFB's home market. Active licensed properties with established referral relationships and full operational infrastructure.

demandNotes: Massive senior population with severe shortage of affordable residential care beds. Average RCFE wait times exceed 90 days in many submarkets.
demographicNotes: Over 2.5 million residents aged 65+ across the basin. Largest senior population in California with the most severe housing cost burden.
description: Expansion target. DFFB is actively reviewing properties and partnership opportunities in LA, Orange, and Inland Empire counties.

demandNotes: Growing retiree population with limited licensed care options. Fresno County 65+ population projected to grow 35% by 2035.
demographicNotes: Lower cost of entry for real estate compared to coastal markets. Strong family caregiving culture creating demand for home-style settings.
description: Development corridor. DFFB is building operator relationships and evaluating properties for future licensed homes.
